authorityClaim: This artifact PROPOSES the scoped host-effect authorization contract D-032 requires before any CA-1 host head, CA-2, CA-3, or host CA-4 act is exercisable. It mints no DR-105 token, no D9 number, and no identity recipe. It applies nothing.

governingDecisions.D-032: ADOPTED: host-under-instruction is outside DR-105; this contract is necessary not sufficient; fail-closed until recorded by Operability+security jointly with Security+platform owners.
governingDecisions.D-035: doctor-contract.v4 is the accepted doctor design contract; this artifact does not reopen it.

inScope: host process acting under the invoking user's direct instruction (CLI/CI)

failClosed.rule: An in-scope host act with no named consent and no recorded contract instance is UNEXERCISABLE. Dependent checks report CONSENT-REQUIRED or the host-outcome INDETERMINATE only when the attempt was made and the result is unknown. Absence never permits.
failClosed.noSilentDowngrade: A denied or unavailable host act does not cause doctor to answer an easier question under the same check id.

mandatoryMinimumPerD032.meaning: The host effect was durably observed to have happened.
The host effect was not performed. Not a revoke-undone claim.
The host cannot honestly say whether the effect happened.

outcomeVocabulary.notGrantJournalOutcomes: COMPLETED-BEFORE-REVOCATION and DR-105 INDETERMINATE-as-grant-outcome are not members. Those remain DR-105 component-tail outcomes.

consent.lifecycle: Bound to one invocation. Not journaled as a DR-105 grant. Cancel or process death ends it.

CA-1-host-head.covers: Decision to spawn an admitted component. The child's subsequent effects are DR-105.

subtypes.route: DR-108; unexercisable while DR-108 is deferred

CA-4-host.covers: Network send or receive by doctor itself.
CA-4-host.slice1ExecutionSide: UNSETTLED which slice-1 doctor egress is host vs component; until settled, host CA-4 is fail-closed unless explicitly consented and this contract instance exists.

whatThisDoesNotDo: Does not apply doctor-contract.v4 or permission-truth-tables.v1.
Does not discharge DR-105 or DR-114 SATISFIED.
Does not decide D-002 identity recipes.
acceptanceEvidenceFixtureClasses: FC-FAIL-CLOSED: unnamed host act is unexercisable
FC-OUTCOME: each of the three outcomes is distinguishable in the post-report
FC-TAIL: spawning a component does not put the child's effects under this contract
FC-KEYCHAIN: KEYCHAIN remains unexercisable while DR-108 is deferred
